investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedarforge Interactive (online gaming); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.48.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cedarf-prod-useast (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 8gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the chat-svc PostgreSQL database chat-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
